units.source_text: 下品之人，往生西方极乐世界时，生在未开莲花之中。

en.t: When people of the lowest grade are reborn in the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, they are born inside lotus flowers that have not yet opened.

units.source_text: 须经过若干劫后，莲花方开。

en.t: Only after many kalpas have passed do the lotus flowers finally open.

units.source_text: 这期间不得见佛，不得听说法，不得供养。

en.t: During that time, they cannot see the Buddha, cannot hear the Dharma being taught, and cannot make offerings.
